offerings.name: Web Search API
offerings.pricing: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results, rounded up. Plans: Free $0/month with 1,000 credits; Hobby $16/month billed annually with 5,000 credits; Standard $83/month billed annually with 100,000 credits; Growth $333/month billed annually with 500,000 credits; Scale $599/month billed annually with 1,000,000 credits. Pay-as-you-go: $5 increments, credits vary by plan.
offerings.price_basis: Credit-based pricing; Search uses 2 credits per 10 results. Credits are shared across endpoints; paid plan and result count affect the effective price.
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits/month; pricing page states this covers 500 searches or 1,000 pages scraped.
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果，包含标题、描述和 URL；可选返回网页 Markdown、HTML、链接或截图
offerings.note: 搜索费用按结果数向上取整；启用内容抓取时还会收取每页抓取费用。
